nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Not bad. Crooked, but not bad.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Out there, the Redaction is sending Errors. Bares, mostly. Poor beasts. Spelling mistakes with teeth.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: You can cut them down. Or you can hold your light on them until they remember what they were.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: The second way takes longer. It's usually worth it.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Here. Hardcover. Heavy. It'll keep the Errors from reading you too closely.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: And these: eraser crumbs. Throw them at anything you'd rather not read.
